name: Diamond Staff

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-5-magic-items. Mechanics checked against the chapter. Prices use the existing rarity convention, not book-specific prices; unspecified weights use 0, and templates inherit base-item weight. Reference-only powers are described in text and have no action button.

magic.attunement: by a Sorcerer, Warlock, or Wizard

summary: +3 to weapon attack and damage; while held, Advantage on Arcana.
text: +3 to weapon attack and damage; while held, Advantage on Arcana. Twenty charges; regain 1d6+4 at dawn. Last charge destroys the staff on a d20 roll of 1. Spells use your DC: Detect Magic and Light at will; Identify 1, Knock 2, True Seeing 3, Legend Lore 5, Maze 8 charges. Reference-only: Tongues at will on yourself; 1 charge creates Bright Light 40 feet and Dim Light 40 more for 1 minute or until commanded off; on a melee hit, spend 2 charges for DC 17 Constitution against Stunned until your next turn ends.
